base_assessment.branched_from: pre-Q34 base (its diff vs Q35 head deletes the Q33/Q34/Q35 production gates)
base_assessment.reason: The LAB predates the Q33/Q34/Q35 production contracts. Its file layout (data/rights, data/agent/duty-contracts, schemas/rights/publication-gate) duplicates and conflicts with the production Q33/Q34/Q35 surfaces that were built later. Only concept-level salvage is viable.

items.lab_concept: Prediction record with object, mechanism, time_range, trigger_conditions, falsification_conditions, observation_period, expiry_status, claim_ceiling
items.decision: The freeze-before-reveal prediction record with explicit falsification conditions and claim_ceiling is the core Q36-OBS concept. Reimplemented as prediction-commitment record with immutable issued_at, input cutoff, outcome window, Q34 commitment ref, Q35 actor ref, exact-head digest binding, and supersession-only correction.
rejected_elements: free-text status field without lifecycle invariants
mechanism as free text (Q36-OBS does not adjudicate mechanism; it records model/rule/version references)

items.lab_concept: Observation record linking to prediction_id with matches_prediction boolean
items.decision: Reimplemented as outcome-binding record: prediction id, outcome observation id, outcome availability time, deterministic matching rule, inclusion/exclusion reason, evaluator, independent evidence status, exact-head/digest binding. The bare boolean matches_prediction is replaced by typed evaluation/calibration records with deterministic metrics.
rejected_elements: matches_prediction boolean (non-deterministic, no metric, no residual)

items.lab_concept: Validator rejecting forbidden causal shortcuts (repository reachability / agent repetition / analogy relation / synchronization obligation as causal proof) and rejecting claim_ceiling containing 'proof'
items.decision: The anti-causal-shortcut checks are reimplemented as deterministic validator rules: correlation/fit/accuracy must not be upgraded to causal mechanism (exit code), claim ceiling must not expand finite-scope performance into universal predictive capability. Reimplemented with stable machine-readable exit codes instead of free-text PASS/FAIL.
rejected_elements: free-text report PASS/FAIL (not machine-readable, not fail-closed by exit code)
hard-coded DATA_DIR with no CLI arguments

items.lab_concept: Generic registry wrapper schema (registry_type, version, entries[])
items.decision: Too permissive (entries is an untyped array). Replaced by five typed schemas under schemas/observation/ with required fields, enums, formats, and additionalProperties constraints.
Intervention execution and counterfactual dynamics belong to Q36-INT. Q36-OBS only exposes read-only residual/anomaly interfaces toward Q36-INT.

items.lab_asset: data/rights/*, data/agent/duty-contracts.json, schemas/rights/*, schemas/agent/agent-duty.schema.json, schemas/discovery/dual-plane.schema.json and their tests
items.decision: Superseded by the production Q33 rights/publication gate, Q34 commitment boundary, and Q35 responsibility-authority-action trace. The LAB variants duplicate production surfaces with incompatible layouts.
Reimplemented as the supersession/correction policy on the prediction-commitment record: post-reveal modification is forbidden; corrections are new supersession records preserving the original.

reimplemented_concepts: freeze-before-reveal prediction record with falsification/evaluation conditions
prediction expiry/supersession as immutable correction records
